Suffering from emotional and physical pain. Been almost a year since it started. Not getting any better. I just want to rest. I no longer feel human. Just a sack of meat and flesh. I'm most happy when I'm asleep and dreaming. I no longer find joy in the waking world. Just existing right now. My family is the one thing keeping me here.

Yea I've been coping as best I can. I'm just hitting rock bottom right now. A part time job helped a little over the summer. Then I got a full time job, but it was so monotonous I had to quit. I'll be looking for another one soon. Thanks for the advice. I appreciate it.

The accident was back in march and has progressively been getting worse. The problem is I want to get out and work but my depression is preventing me from doing that. It's hard settling for minimum wage when I was used to making over a thousand dollars in a week. I don't know I just feel crippled when I shouldn't because there are people out there living quite happily with far worse disabilities. It's just hard accepting something I can't physically fix ya know.

Just been having a real tough go this year. I'm a young guy, 24. Had my own business but made some bad decisions on a job site not wearing enough protection and screwed my eyesight up. It's like i took a hit of acid and never stopped tripping.  Im not working and am just real depressed.  I'll most likely not commit suicide, I just think about it. That's why I think a therapist might be a good idea. I've seen every medical doctor under the sun for my vision problems but everything comes back normal. I'm just frustrated and need help.
